name: Mica
description: A geomancer who helps Quint find a Coin Empire reliquary.

description_citations.text: "Quintorius". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint tells Dean Tullus of the discovery, and she assigns the geomancer Mica to go with him.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Quint and Mica return to the cache and find objects moved and some missing.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Mica uncovers fossil footprints matching the creature from Colony's End and a mosaic of a tentacled horror, showing the Coin Empire reached Arcavios.
timeline.quote: The Coin Empire had definitely reached Arcavios.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Field Studies in a Future Tense" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Two years later Quint returns to Strixhaven as a temporary teaching assistant and with Mica finds a Coin Empire reliquary depicting the Fomori-Eldrazi war.
timeline.quote: he discovered a Coin Empire reliquary, including a depiction of the Fomori-Eldrazi war

citation.text: "Quintorius", section "Return to Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
